intro.h2: Kitchen Remodeling in Hilton Head, Built for Island Homes
paragraphs: Hilton Head Home Solutions handles kitchen remodeling on Hilton Head Island, including villa kitchens. In one small villa, the team opened the enclosed kitchen to the living area, replaced the old cabinets and installed new granite, a backsplash, a faucet and a sink.

Customers come back for more. Susan J. hired them for several projects inside and outside her home, and Kathy B. says they complete the job as quoted and on time. When Debbie T. needed an emergency bathroom redo and could not get there right away, it was done within 10 days. The same team also handles painting, drywall, flooring and carpentry.

services.h2: Remodeling Services on Hilton Head Island

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchen updates for island homes and villas: old cabinets out, new cabinets in, granite counters, a tiled backsplash and a new faucet and sink. In one small villa, the team also opened the enclosed kitchen to the living room, and in their words the difference is huge.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with light gray shaker cabinets, white veined countertop, mosaic tile backsplash and glass pendant lights

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Full bathroom remodels and urgent redos. One homeowner who could not be on site had an emergency bathroom redo finished within 10 days. She wrote that Fernanda took care of everything, that the work was quality and that the crew cleaned up well.

items.name: Flooring, including epoxy
items.blurb: New flooring to finish a remodel, plus epoxy floors for garages and home gyms. For epoxy, their offer is simple: you choose the color and they do the rest. Ask about flooring when you plan a kitchen or bath so it all happens in one project.

image.alt: Galley kitchen with light wood-look plank flooring, stainless steel appliances and light gray cabinets

items.name: Painting, drywall and carpentry
items.blurb: Painting, drywall and carpentry for a single room or a whole home. Their Facebook page lists these trades alongside flooring, general remodeling and kitchen and bath work, and their posts say no job is too small, so small repairs are worth a call.

items.text: Susan J. hired them for several projects both inside and outside her home. Kitchens, baths, floors, paint, drywall and carpentry are all handled by one local team.

about.h2: A Local Team With 10 Years of Experience
about.text: Hilton Head Home Solutions works from 18 Executive Park Road on Hilton Head Island and says it has 10 years of experience behind it. One team covers painting, carpentry, drywall, flooring and kitchen and bath remodeling, so you do not have to line up separate trades for one project. Fernanda Lossada is the company's project manager, and reviewers mention her by name. The owners reply to their Google reviews, and customers like Susan J. have hired the team for several projects in and around the same home.

image.alt: Bright dining and living area with a wood-plank vaulted ceiling, wood beam, wood-look floors and windows looking out over the water

steps.title: Call or message
steps.text: Call (843) 227-4087 or message the team on Facebook or Instagram about the room you want to change, and ask for a free estimate.

steps.title: Quote
steps.text: Go over the scope and the quote before any work starts. Reviewers say their jobs were completed as quoted and on time.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The crew does the work, from cabinets, counters and tile to flooring and paint. If you are off the island, the project manager can take care of things on site.

steps.title: Clean up and walkthrough
steps.text: The site is cleaned up and you walk through the finished room together before the job is closed out.

items.name: Kathy B.
items.text: Hilton Head Home Solutions is extremely well run. They are very responsive, they complete the job as quoted and on time, and the workmanship is excellent. In addition, they are very pleasant to work with.

items.name: Debbie T.
items.text: We had an emergency redo for a bathroom.  They were able to get it done within 10 days.  Fernanda was great to work with and took care of everything since we were not able to get there immediately.  The work was quality and they cleaned up well.  We are ready to a planned renovation next with them.  Highly recommend the company.

items.name: Susan J.
items.text: I contracted Hilton Head Home Solutions to work on several projects, both inside and outside my home. Each job was performed with such professionalism and met with my full satisfaction. I highly recommend this company for any project you might have. You won't be disappointed!

service_area.text: The office is at 18 Executive Park Rd #3 on Hilton Head Island, and the kitchens and rooms the team shares online are island homes and villas. If you live on the island or own a place here, call to check whether your project and timing fit their schedule. Owners who cannot be on site can still get work done, as one reviewer did.

items.a: Yes. Hilton Head Home Solutions invites homeowners to contact them for a free estimate. Call (843) 227-4087 Monday to Saturday between 8 AM and 5 PM, or send a message through Facebook or Instagram, to talk about your project and set up the estimate.

items.q: What kind of work do you take on?
items.a: Kitchen and bathroom remodeling, flooring including epoxy floors, painting, drywall, carpentry and general remodeling. Their kitchen work includes opening a small villa kitchen to the living room with new cabinets, granite, backsplash, faucet and sink. They also say no job is too small, so small repairs are worth a call.

items.q: Can you manage a project if I am not on the island?
items.a: Debbie T., who could not be there in person at first, had an emergency bathroom redo finished within 10 days, and wrote that Fernanda, the project manager, took care of everything. Call to talk through access, updates and timing for your own project before work starts.

items.q: Where is your office and when are you open?
items.a: The office is at 18 Executive Park Rd #3, Hilton Head Island, SC 29928. The listed hours are Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and the office is closed on Sunday. Calling ahead before you visit is the easiest way to make sure someone is there.

items.q: How long have you been in business?
items.a: The company says it has 10 years of experience behind it. On Google it holds a 5.0 rating from 6 reviews, and the owners reply to their reviews. Reviewers mention jobs done as quoted and on time, a clean finish, and planning the next project with the same team.

final_cta.text: Call the Hilton Head Island office for a free estimate on your kitchen, bathroom or next project.
